concerns.text: FR-002 is conditional: 'System MUST download a dedicated ... population synthesis catalog ... If no verified external source exists, the system MUST generate a synthetic catalog.' T003 implements only the generation path; no task attempts the download from a configured community repository or records the source-verification decision. The conditional half of FR-002 is silently dropped, weakening the requirement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T007 vs spec.md:FR-009 and Edge Cases
concerns.text: FR-009 specifies α ∈ {0.05, 0.06}; the spec's edge case specifies {0.04, 0.05, 0.06}; T007 defaults to [0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.10]. The task's sweep set does not include the FR-mandated values (0.06 is absent from the default set), so the FR-009 sweep is not performed as specified and 'borderline' flip semantics are ill-defined.

No task measures runtime, peak memory, or peak disk. T011 only documents 'resource expectations'; the claim that FR-011 is 'validated by the platform runner, not by project-written CI files' conflates not writing CI files with not measuring. SC-004/005/006 have no verification step in any task, so the P0 constraint (US-0) is unverified.

T004/T006 target ks_results.json conforming to statistical_test_result.schema.yaml (requires alpha_threshold, scope; additionalProperties: false), while T008 emits power_analysis.json 'per the result schema' which requires nested alpha_sweep_results and power_analysis inside each KS result. The two schemas are mutually exclusive for the same output; tasks cannot satisfy both, so the schema constraint is contradictory as carried into tasks.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T005/T009 vs constitution.md:Principle VII and spec.md:Assumptions
concerns.text: Constitution Principle VII mandates the pipeline be executable on a single CPU core; the spec assumes '≥2 CPU cores'. No task states which constraint the implementation targets (e.g., no single-core enforcement or note in T011's resource expectations), leaving a constitution constraint unpreserved in the task list.

The Phase-1 thin pass runs KS on single-point medians, which FR-014 forbids ('rather than single-point medians'). T006 supersedes it, but the checkpoint presents the thin-pass outputs as valid checkable results without labeling them provisional/scaffolding. Make the staging explicit so the checkpoint is not read as satisfying FR-014.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T005/T009 vs plan.md:Project Structure and data-model.md:Data Flow
concerns.text: Artifact paths diverge from the plan/data-model: selection weights at data/results/selection_weights.csv (plan: data/processed/), figures at figures/ (plan/data-model: outputs/figures/). Align to one canonical path set to preserve the SSoT traceability constraint (Principle IV).
